cues.en: So just like we can run PCA on a 4-dimensional Iris data set, we can also run it on our multidimensional movie rating data set, where every dimension is a movie.
cues.zh: 就像可以對四維鳶尾花資料集做 PCA，也能對多維電影評分資料集做 PCA，每一維都是一部電影。

cues.en: We'll call this ratings matrix that has users as rows R.
cues.zh: 把以使用者為列的評分矩陣，稱為 R。

cues.en: Just like it did with our Iris data set, PCA can boil this down to a much smaller number of dimensions that best describe the variance in the data.
cues.zh: 如同鳶尾花資料集，PCA 能把它濃縮成少得多、最能描述資料變異的維度。

cues.en: And often, the dimensions it finds correspond to features humans have learned to associate with movies as well, for example, how action-y is a movie?
cues.zh: 它找出的維度，往往也對應到人類與電影連結的特徵，例如，一部電影有多偏動作？

cues.en: How romantic is it?
cues.zh: 有多浪漫？

cues.en: How funny is it?
cues.zh: 有多好笑？

cues.en: Whatever it is about movies that causes individuals to rate them differently, PCA will find those latent features and extract them from the data.
cues.zh: 不管電影的哪些因素，讓不同人給出不同評分，PCA 都會找出那些潛在特徵，從資料中擷取。

cues.en: PCA doesn't know what they mean, but it finds them nonetheless.
cues.zh: PCA 不知道意義，但仍然能找出來。

cues.en: So, we could ask PCA to distill things down to say three dimensions in this example, and it would boil our ratings down to three latent features it identified.
cues.zh: 因此，這個例子可以請 PCA 濃縮到三維，把評分歸納成它識別出的三個潛在特徵。

cues.en: PCA won't know what to call them, but let's say they end up being measures of each person's interest in action, sci-fi, and classic genres.
cues.zh: PCA 不知道該如何命名，但假設最後分別衡量每個人對動作、科幻與經典類型的興趣。

cues.en: So for example, we might think of Bob as being defined as 30% action, 50% sci-fi, and 20% classic in terms of his interests.
cues.zh: 例如，可以認為 Bob 的興趣由 30% 動作、50% 科幻、20% 經典構成。

cues.en: Now, take a look at the columns in this new matrix.
cues.zh: 現在，看看新矩陣的欄。

cues.en: Each column is a description of users that make up that feature.
cues.zh: 每一欄，描述構成該特徵的使用者。

cues.en: Action can be described as 30% of Bob plus 10% of Ted plus 30% of Ann.
cues.zh: 動作特徵，可以描述為 30% 的 Bob，加 10% 的 Ted，再加 30% 的 Ann。

cues.en: Let's call this matrix U, its columns describe typical users for each latent feature we produced.
cues.zh: 把這個矩陣稱為 U，每一欄描述某個潛在特徵的典型使用者。

cues.en: Just like we can run PCA on our user ratings data to find profiles of typical kinds of users, we can flip things around and run PCA to find profiles of typical kinds of movies.
cues.zh: 就像對使用者評分資料做 PCA，找出典型使用者輪廓，也能反過來做 PCA，找出典型電影輪廓。

cues.en: If we re-arrange our input data so that movies are rows and users are columns, it would look like this.
cues.zh: 把輸入資料重新排列，讓電影為列、使用者為欄，就像這樣。

cues.en: We call this the transpose of the original ratings matrix, or R-T for short.
cues.zh: 這叫做原始評分矩陣的轉置，簡寫 Rᵀ。

cues.en: Now if we run PCA on that, it will identify the latent features again, and describe each individual movie as some combination of them.
cues.zh: 現在對它做 PCA，也會找出潛在特徵，將每部電影描述成這些特徵的某種組合。

cues.en: Each column is now a description of some typical movie that exhibits some latent feature.
cues.zh: 每一欄，現在描述一部呈現某個潛在特徵的典型電影。

cues.en: Again, these have no inherent meaning, but in practice it might fall along movie genre lines.
cues.zh: 同樣地，沒有內在固定意義，但實務上可能沿著電影類型區分。

cues.en: In reality though, it's more complex.
cues.zh: 不過，現實更複雜。

cues.en: Let's call this resulting matrix that describes typical movies M.
cues.zh: 把描述典型電影的結果矩陣，稱為 M。

cues.en: So how do these matrices that describe typical users and typical movies help us to predict ratings?
cues.zh: 這些描述典型使用者與典型電影的矩陣，如何幫助預測評分？

cues.en: Well, it turns out that the typical movie matrix and the typical user matrix's transpose are both factors of the original rating matrix we started with.
cues.zh: 原來，典型電影矩陣與典型使用者矩陣的轉置，都是最初原始評分矩陣的因子。

cues.en: So if we have M and we have U, we can reconstruct R.
cues.zh: 因此，有了 M 與 U，就能重建 R。

cues.en: And if R is missing some ratings, if we have M and U we can fill in all of those blanks in R.
cues.zh: 如果 R 缺少部分評分，有了 M 與 U，就能填滿 R 中的所有空白。

cues.en: That's why we call this matrix factorization.
cues.zh: 所以叫做矩陣分解。

cues.en: We describe our training data in terms of smaller matrices that are factors of the ratings we want to predict.
cues.zh: 用較小的矩陣描述訓練資料，它們是我們想預測的評分矩陣的因子。

cues.en: There is also that sigma matrix in the middle that we haven't talked about that we need.
cues.zh: 中間還有一個尚未談到、但也需要的 Σ 矩陣。

cues.en: It's just a simple diagonal matrix that only serves to scale the values we end up with into the proper scale.
cues.zh: 它只是簡單的對角矩陣，用來把最終數值縮放到正確尺度。

cues.en: You could just multiply that scaling matrix into M or U, and still think of R as just the product of two matrices if that makes it easier to wrap your head around it.
cues.zh: 如果更容易理解，也可以把縮放矩陣乘進 M 或 U，仍把 R 想成只有兩個矩陣的乘積。

cues.en: So, you could reconstruct R all at once by multiplying these factors together, and get ratings for every combination of users and items.
cues.zh: 因此，將這些因子相乘，就能一次重建 R，取得每種使用者與項目組合的評分。

cues.en: Once you have these factors though, you can also just predict a rating for a specific user and item by taking the dot product of the associated row in U for the user, and the associated column in M-T
cues.zh: 不過，一旦有這些因子，也能只預測特定使用者與項目的評分：取 U 中該使用者對應的列，以及 Mᵀ 中

cues.en: for the item.
cues.zh: 該項目對應的欄，做內積。

cues.en: That's just how matrix multiplication works.
cues.zh: 矩陣乘法就是這樣運作。

cues.en: Finally, we're going to tie it all together.
cues.zh: 最後，把所有內容串起來。

cues.en: A few times in this course we've used a built-in recommender called SVD, and it's known to produce very accurate results.
cues.zh: 這門課已經用過幾次內建的 SVD 推薦系統，它以預測非常準確聞名。

cues.en: It was used widely during the Netflix Prize amongst the leaders in the competition.
cues.zh: Netflix Prize 的領先參賽者，廣泛使用它。

cues.en: SVD stands for singular value decomposition.
cues.zh: SVD 是奇異值分解的縮寫。

cues.en: Know what singular value decomposition does?
cues.zh: 知道奇異值分解做什麼嗎？

cues.en: It's a way of computing U, Sigma, and M-T together all at once very efficiently.
cues.zh: 它能非常有效率地，一次算出 U、Σ 與 Mᵀ。

cues.en: So all SVD is doing is running PCA on both the users and the items, and giving us back the matrices we need that are factors of the ratings matrix we want.
cues.zh: 所以 SVD 做的，只是同時對使用者與項目做 PCA，傳回我們需要、構成評分矩陣因子的矩陣。

cues.en: SVD is just way to get all three of those factors in one shot.
cues.zh: SVD 就是一次取得三個因子的方法。

cues.en: But wait, how do we compute U and M-T when our original matrix R is missing most of its values?
cues.zh: 等等，原始矩陣 R 大部分數值缺失時，怎麼算 U 與 Mᵀ？

cues.en: You can't run PCA on a matrix where most of it is missing, it must be a complete matrix.
cues.zh: 不能對大部分資料缺失的矩陣做 PCA，必須是完整矩陣。

cues.en: You could just fill in the missing values with some sort of reasonable default values, like mean values of some sort, and this is what people did at first.
cues.zh: 可以用合理預設值，例如某種平均值，填入缺失資料，早期人們確實這麼做。

cues.en: But, there's a better way.
cues.zh: 但有更好的方法。

cues.en: Remember every rating can be described as the dot product of some row in the matrix U and some column in the matrix M-T.
cues.zh: 記得，每筆評分，都能描述為 U 中某一列，與 Mᵀ 中某一欄的內積。

cues.en: For example, if we want to predict Bob's rating for The Empire Strikes Back, we can compute that as the dot product of the Bob row in U and the Empire Strikes Back column in M-T.
cues.zh: 例如，要預測 Bob 對《帝國大反擊》的評分，就計算 U 的 Bob 列，與 Mᵀ 的《帝國大反擊》欄的內積。

cues.en: So, let's assume we have at least some known ratings for any given row and column in U and M-T.
cues.zh: 因此，假設 U 與 Mᵀ 中，每一組相關列與欄，都至少有一些已知評分。

cues.en: We can treat this as a minimization problem, where we try to find the values of those complete rows and columns that best minimize the errors in the known ratings in R.
cues.zh: 可以將它視為最小化問題，尋找完整列與欄中的值，讓 R 中已知評分的誤差最小。

cues.en: There are lots of machine learning techniques that can do that sort of thing, such as Stochastic Gradient Descent, or SGD for short.
cues.zh: 很多機器學習技術能做這類事情，例如隨機梯度下降，簡稱 SGD。

cues.en: Basically it just keeps iterating at some given learning rate until it arrives at a minimum error value.
cues.zh: 基本上，就是以指定學習率不斷迭代，直到誤差達到最小值。

cues.en: We could talk about SGD in more depth, but I think I've made your head hurt enough for now.
cues.zh: 可以更深入談 SGD，但我想現在已經讓你夠頭痛了。

cues.en: And we'll return to SGD when we talk about neural networks, because it comes into play there as well.
cues.zh: 談神經網路時，會再回到 SGD，因為那裡也會用到。

cues.en: And again, SGD is just one way to do it.
cues.zh: 再次強調，SGD 只是一種方法。

cues.en: Apache Spark for example uses a different technique called alternating least squares, or ALS.
cues.zh: 例如 Apache Spark 使用另一種技術，叫做交替最小平方法，簡稱 ALS。

cues.en: You might be confused here because all of a sudden we're talking about learning the values in the matrices M and U, and not computing them directly which is what SVD does.
cues.zh: 你可能困惑，因為突然變成學習 M 與 U 的值，而不是像 SVD 那樣直接計算。

cues.en: And, you're right to be confused.
cues.zh: 你覺得困惑，是對的。

cues.en: When we say we're doing SVD recommendations, it's not really SVD, because you can't do real SVD with missing data.
cues.zh: 所謂的 SVD 推薦，實際上不是真正的 SVD，因為缺失資料時，無法做真正的 SVD。

cues.en: It's an SVD-inspired algorithm that was invented for the Netflix Prize, but it's not really pure SVD.
cues.zh: 它是在 Netflix Prize 期間發明、受 SVD 啟發的演算法，但並不是純粹的 SVD。

cues.en: The winner of the Netflix prize was a combination of a specific variant of SVD called SVD++, and another technique called Restricted Boltzmann Machines, but that's a story for another section.
cues.zh: Netflix Prize 冠軍結合一種稱為 SVD++ 的特定 SVD 變形，以及另一種稱為受限玻爾茲曼機的技術，但那是另一節的故事。

cues.en: I realize this is all pretty tough to wrap your head around, and you might want to watch this section again to help it sink in.
cues.zh: 我知道這些內容很難理解，也許需要重看這一節，讓它慢慢消化。

cues.en: But the important points are this: you can think of all ratings for a set of users and items as a matrix R, and that matrix R can be factored into smaller matrices that describe general categories of users
cues.zh: 但重點是：可以把一組使用者與項目的所有評分，看成矩陣 R，R 又能分解成較小矩陣，描述一般的使用者

cues.en: and items that can be multiplied together.
cues.zh: 與項目類別，並能彼此相乘。

cues.en: A quick way to get those matrices is a technique called SVD, singular value decomposition, and once you have those factored matrices, you can predict the rating of any item by any user
cues.zh: 快速取得這些矩陣的一種技術，是 SVD，也就是奇異值分解。有了分解出的矩陣，就能預測任何使用者對任何項目的評分，

cues.en: by just taking a dot product from each matrix.
cues.zh: 只要從每個矩陣取對應資料做內積。

cues.en: Techniques such as SGD, stochastic gradient descent, and ALS, alternating least squares, can be used to learn the best values of those factored matrices when you have missing data.
cues.zh: 有缺失資料時，可以使用 SGD 隨機梯度下降、ALS 交替最小平方法等技術，學習這些因子矩陣的最佳值。
